name: evidentia
description: Medical and scientific citation verification for Codex. Catches fabricated DOIs, invalid PMIDs, arXiv IDs, NCT records, and bibliographic mismatches.

interface.shortDescription: Catch fabricated medical and scientific citations.
interface.longDescription: Evidentia verifies citations against CrossRef, PubMed, OpenAlex, arXiv, and ClinicalTrials.gov, flags fabricated or mismatched references, and provides a medical fact-checking skill for full evidence appraisal.
defaultPrompt: Verify the citations in this manuscript.
Audit this health post for evidence quality.
